title: A boundary-identifiability framework for energy comparisons in lunar-regolith construction experiments: reproducibility package

creators.name: Ren, Lijian
creators.affiliation: Inner Mongolia University of Technology; Hohai University

description: Public reproducibility package for a boundary-identifiability analysis of energy comparisons in lunar-regolith construction experiments. The V328 archive contains typed boundary states, a claim-indexed comparability graph, point/partial/nonidentification rules, reporting-repair and sensitivity analyses, nine source-visible numerical cases, five figure source sets, derived discovery and coding metadata, and executable checks. It excludes active submission manuscripts, submission PDFs and LaTeX packages, cover letters, reviewer-response drafts, internal rounds/logs, raw third-party article PDFs, credentials, and private author/funding files.
